generation_parents.algorithm: The new algorithm keeps nearest-neighbor for depot starts, and in-route uses a savings score with a distance penalty whose strength is scaled by a smooth capacity-tightness ratio, adding a demand bonus only when residual capacity is tight, with a different threshold and functional form than the reference.

declared_hypothesis: A slightly different threshold may improve packing without overriding the savings rule.
